issues.concern: The translation 'local train' for 普通の電車 is misleading. While 普通電車 (futsū densha) can refer to a local train (stopping at every station), 普通の電車 in this context simply means 'an ordinary train' or 'a regular train' as opposed to a faster express train, which is implied by 'it took a long time.' The nuance of 'local train' isn't explicitly present in 普通の電車 without further context.
issues.suggestion: Change 'I took the local train, so it took a long time.' to 'I took an ordinary train, so it took a long time.' or 'I took a regular train, so it took a long time.'
